messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning final vendor/lockfile/submodule bumps before tomorrow's cutoff (2025-05-18 09:00 PT). If you're touching submodules or regenerating vendor/, please coordinate here so we don't step on each other.

jon: Working on grpc submodule update (bumping to latest patch). Will open the PR in ~30m and add changelog.

liam: Doing a vendor regen for libhttp and some go deps. Ran into conflicts in vendor/ with go.mod — got a few merge markers. Any preferred workflow?

sasha: For regen conflicts I usually: 
1) checkout release branch 
2) ./scripts/regen-vendor.sh 
3) git add vendor go.mod go.sum && git commit -m "vendor: regen libhttp@v1.2.3"
Push to a feature branch and open PR. Keep the vendor commit separate from other functional changes.

ryan: Also add this to CI matrix if not present: 
```
- name: sync submodules
  run: |
    git submodule sync --recursive
    git submodule update --init --remote
```
We saw flakes when CI containers didn't init submodules.

dev-bot: [CI] vendor-check job triggered by jon/PR#952 — started

maya: Important policy note: do NOT bump transitive major versions right before cutoff unless you've got release manager sign-off. Stick to patch/minor unless the dependency change is explicitly approved. Also add a changelog entry under Unreleased -> Dependency bumps.

jon: Ack. I'll keep to patch/minor and include the changelog entry. Will also label with /cherry-pick if it's needed post-cutoff.

liam: Who can eyeball a generated vendor diff quickly? It's large but we just need a sanity pass (no binary blobs, no new licenses).

sasha: I can do a quick pass after lunch. ETA ~13:30 PT.

jon: When updating submodule SHAs, put the full sha in the PR body and a short commit message example, e.g.:
```
submodule: update grpc to 4a7b2f3
vendor: regen
```
Keeps the changelog traceable.

liam: Good call. Also adding a checksum guard to the regen script so CI fails loudly if vendor/ changes unexpectedly:
```
sha256sum -c vendor/SHA256SUMS || (./scripts/regen-vendor.sh && exit 1)
```
That saved me last week.

ops-bot: Reminder: release cutoff is 2025-05-18 09:00 PT. After that only urgent fixes allowed.

maya: If you need merge-queue priority for a dependency bump, ping me with the PR link and a short reason. I'll allocate a slot if it's low-risk.

jon: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/952 — includes grpc submodule bump + vendor regen + changelog entry. Added CI fixes (submodule init).

dev-bot: [CI] vendor-check passed. lint ok. integration-tests queued.

sasha: Quick review done. Left one nit about an import path in docs referencing the old package name. Otherwise looks fine.

liam: Thanks — I'll fix the doc import and push.

jon: Updated PR, included changelog under "Unreleased -> Dependency bumps" and added the full submodule sha in the body. Requesting merge slot.

maya: Granting merge slot Q2 (next 20m). Add label merge-queue/slot-2.

ryan: FYI: for large vendor diffs (>5k lines) prefer a squashed vendor commit with message like "vendor: regen YYYY-MM-DD" to keep history readable. We keep the submodule bump separate if possible.

jon: Will squash to a single vendor commit.

maya: Also a quick perf note — after vendor bumps please glance at Dedicated CI latency benchmarks; some deps changed behavior in the past and impacted p99s.

jon: Will monitor perf dashboard after merge.

dev-bot: [merge-queue] PR 952 assigned slot-2 by maya.

ops-bot: Deploy window: non-blocking — feature merges allowed until cutoff.

sasha: Starting the final merge in 10 if CI stays green.

jon: CI green. merging now :thumbsup:

dev-bot: [merge-queue] PR 952 merged by jon into release/v1.4

maya: Thanks everyone — vendor/submodule side is cleared for this cut. If you have additional vendor or submodule updates, coordinate here before cutoff or we'll queue them for the post-cut patch.

ryan: noted.

End of thread.
